dbPath.label: Database path
dbPath.help: Optional override for the agenr knowledge database. Defaults to the dbPath in agenr's config.json, then ~/.agenr/knowledge.db.

configPath.label: Config path
configPath.help: Optional path to agenr's config.json. Defaults to AGENR_CONFIG_PATH, then config.json next to dbPath when dbPath is set, then ~/.agenr/config.json.

continuityModel.label: Continuity summary model
continuityModel.help: Optional model override for continuity summary generation (provider/model format). Falls back to the agent's primary model when unset.

episodeModel.label: Episode summary model
episodeModel.help: Optional model override for episode summary generation (provider/model format). Falls back to the agent's primary model when unset.

claimExtractionModel.label: Claim extraction model
claimExtractionModel.help: Model used for claim-key extraction when storing entries. Uses OpenClaw's configured auth. Format: provider/model (for example, openai/gpt-5.4-nano). Defaults to the agent's primary model.

continuityModel.description: Model override for continuity summary generation (e.g. 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini'). Falls back to the agent's primary model.

episodeModel.description: Model override for episode summary generation (e.g. 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini'). Falls back to the agent's primary model.

claimExtractionModel.description: Model override for claim-key extraction at store time (e.g. 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini'). Uses OpenClaw auth and falls back to the agent's primary model.
